summary:
Reviewed w211's fix loop: 025433c3 and 4618d2d7. They are the same commits as the results' 7b3f8f29 and cb1aaaef, rebased at the merge, and touch only scripts/workqueue_request.py.
No test was removed or weakened, nothing under features/ changed, and no allowance was claimed.
tools check: ruff, vulture and import-linter are clean. tools size: no file is over 300 lines.
Review 10's fix-now finding (reply has no r34 side check) no longer applies: the answer of 2026-10-27 accepts it and defers the check to w212.
One observation stands (Important, observation): an internal request raised with only --thread in a repository that lists upstreams is refused every outcome, ask and resolve. A probe reproduces it. The fix needs a line, so it belongs with w212's design.
No scenario covers the new ask and resolve refusals; only the probe exercises them.
